horizons_after_verdict.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND '714;', geocentric astrometric RA/Dec moved to the spacecraft with the FITS header position and Horizons delta
horizons_after_verdict.note: after the verdict; it does not change the status. D^2 uses the frozen C_pred only (no measurement term), so it asks whether the catalogue position lay inside the frozen 95% region.
